item.title: Verbose beta 364
item.description:
Recent dictations on the Mac

Mac

  • Home shows your three newest dictations. Click one to copy it. The section sits above Recent recordings. See all opens Dictations, and Edit Home hides or moves it.
  • The Library's filter row has a Dictations chip. Click a dictation to copy it. Dictations list by day, newest first. Copy turns into Copied when the words are on the clipboard.

Release notes on GitHub
